say:1:1623113001:1.text: A naughty cat's been sneaking into the library. That alone wouldn't be a problem... except a student swears he saw it run off with a magic scroll.
say:1:1623113001:1.source_cn: 最近有只调皮的猫跑进了图书馆，本来没什么大碍，但有学生...
say:1:1623113001:1.male: A naughty cat's been sneaking into the library. That alone wouldn't be a problem... except a student swears he saw it run off with a magic scroll.
say:1:1623113001:1.female: A naughty cat's been sneaking into the library. That alone wouldn't be a problem... except a student swears he saw it run off with a magic scroll.

say:2:1623113002:1.text: I have no idea why our rules didn't work... but if this keeps up, someone's going to propose a new ban on animals in the Serene Lyceum.
say:2:1623113002:1.source_cn: 虽然不清楚那只猫到底是怎么突破了校规的限制……但这样下...
say:2:1623113002:1.male: I have no idea why our rules didn't work... but if this keeps up, someone's going to propose a new ban on animals in the Serene Lyceum.
say:2:1623113002:1.female: I have no idea why our rules didn't work... but if this keeps up, someone's going to propose a new ban on animals in the Serene Lyceum.

say:3:1623113003:1.text: There are already too many dos and don'ts. Take away the animals as well, and the whole place will feel utterly bland, like a soup without seasoning.
say:3:1623113003:1.source_cn: 学校里的条条框框已经够多了，如果再没有了小动物，这里会...
say:3:1623113003:1.male: There are already too many dos and don'ts. Take away the animals as well, and the whole place will feel utterly bland, like a soup without seasoning.
say:3:1623113003:1.female: There are already too many dos and don'ts. Take away the animals as well, and the whole place will feel utterly bland, like a soup without seasoning.

say:4:1623113004:1.text: Animals tend to trust you. Keep an eye out whenever you pass the library.
say:4:1623113004:1.source_cn: 动物们平时很愿意亲近你，你路过图书馆的时候，可以留意一...
say:4:1623113004:1.male: Animals tend to trust you. Keep an eye out whenever you pass the library.
say:4:1623113004:1.female: Animals tend to trust you. Keep an eye out whenever you pass the library.

say:0:1623114001:0.text: Our cat thief must have left some clues.
say:0:1623114001:0.source_cn: 猫咪“作案”，总该留点线索吧。
say:0:1623114001:0.male: Our cat thief must have left some clues.
say:0:1623114001:0.female: Our cat thief must have left some clues.

say:0:1623115001:0.text: This tuft of fur is all I need. Transfiguration can do the rest.
say:0:1623115001:0.source_cn: 有了这撮猫毛，就可以用变形术追踪了。
say:0:1623115001:0.male: This tuft of fur is all I need. Transfiguration can do the rest.
say:0:1623115001:0.female: This tuft of fur is all I need. Transfiguration can do the rest.

say:1:1623117001:1.text: Skip the small talk. What do you want?
say:1:1623117001:1.male: Skip the small talk. What do you want?
say:1:1623117001:1.female: Skip the small talk. What do you want?

choice_prompt:2:1623117001.text: Skip the small talk. What do you want?
choice_prompt:2:1623117001.male: Skip the small talk. What do you want?
choice_prompt:2:1623117001.female: Skip the small talk. What do you want?

say:3:1623117002:1.text: That scroll? Sure, you can have it back... but first, pet me. I'm a cat. It's the law.
say:3:1623117002:1.source_cn: 那个卷轴啊，你想要拿走也不是不行啦……只不过，你要不要...
say:3:1623117002:1.male: That scroll? Sure, you can have it back... but first, pet me. I'm a cat. It's the law.
say:3:1623117002:1.female: That scroll? Sure, you can have it back... but first, pet me. I'm a cat. It's the law.

choice_prompt:4:1623117002.text: That scroll? Sure, you can have it back... but first, pet me. I'm a cat. It's the law.
choice_prompt:4:1623117002.source_cn: 那个卷轴啊，你想要拿走也不是不行啦……只不过，你要不要先摸我一下？我可是小猫咪！
choice_prompt:4:1623117002.male: That scroll? Sure, you can have it back... but first, pet me. I'm a cat. It's the law.
choice_prompt:4:1623117002.female: That scroll? Sure, you can have it back... but first, pet me. I'm a cat. It's the law.

say:5:1623117003:1.text: The cat purrs loudly while she holds her head high like a hard-to-please noble.
say:5:1623117003:1.source_cn: 猫咪喉咙里立刻发出响亮的呼噜声，身体却僵硬地保持着高傲姿态。

say:6:1623117004:1.source_cn: 呼噜噜……手法马马虎虎吧……呼噜……算你将将及格。

say:7:1623117010:1.text: Fine. I'll go easy on you. Bring me the right food and I'll return the scroll. Like... a freshly-caught fish?
say:7:1623117010:1.source_cn: 好吧，我也不为难你。只要你给我合适的食物，我就把卷轴还...
say:7:1623117010:1.male: Fine. I'll go easy on you. Bring me the right food and I'll return the scroll. Like... a freshly-caught fish?
say:7:1623117010:1.female: Fine. I'll go easy on you. Bring me the right food and I'll return the scroll. Like... a freshly-caught fish?

say:8:1623117011:1.text: Don't worry, I always keep my word. Fresh fish for the scroll.
say:8:1623117011:1.source_cn: 放心，我从来都说话算话。用鲜鱼交换卷轴，就这么说定了！
say:8:1623117011:1.male: Don't worry, I always keep my word. Fresh fish for the scroll.
say:8:1623117011:1.female: Don't worry, I always keep my word. Fresh fish for the scroll.

say:10:1623117005:1.text: Mm... There. Yes. And a little to the left.
say:10:1623117005:1.male: Mm... There. Yes. And a little to the left.
say:10:1623117005:1.female: Mm... There. Yes. And a little to the left.

say:11:1623117006:1.text: The cat arches into your hand on reflex, eyes narrowing with satisfaction.
say:11:1623117006:1.source_cn: 猫咪身体不自觉地拱起迎合着你，舒服得眯起眼。
say:11:1623117006:1.male: The cat arches into your hand on reflex, eyes narrowing with satisfaction.
say:11:1623117006:1.female: The cat arches into your hand on reflex, eyes narrowing with satisfaction.

say:12:1623117007:1.text: I'm only allowing this because I needed it. My back itches. Consider yourself lucky.
say:12:1623117007:1.source_cn: 哼，要不是我今天背痒，才不会让你摸这里，算是便宜你了。
say:12:1623117007:1.male: I'm only allowing this because I needed it. My back itches. Consider yourself lucky.
say:12:1623117007:1.female: I'm only allowing this because I needed it. My back itches. Consider yourself lucky.

say:14:1623117009:1.text: Tch. I'm going to sunbathe. Petting won't work now... unless...
say:14:1623117009:1.source_cn: 啧，我要去晒太阳了，现在你摸我也没用了……除非……
say:14:1623117009:1.male: Tch. I'm going to sunbathe. Petting won't work now... unless...
say:14:1623117009:1.female: Tch. I'm going to sunbathe. Petting won't work now... unless...

say:0:1623118001:0.text: That's a big catch. The cat's going to be thrilled.
say:0:1623118001:0.source_cn: 这条鱼挺大，那只猫看见了准会高兴。
say:0:1623118001:0.male: That's a big catch. The cat's going to be thrilled.
say:0:1623118001:0.female: That's a big catch. The cat's going to be thrilled.

say:1:1623119001:1.text: Mmm, excellent. Freshest fish possible. As promised. Here's your scroll.
say:1:1623119001:1.source_cn: 真不错，是最新鲜的鱼。按照我们的约定，我把卷轴还给你。
say:1:1623119001:1.male: Mmm, excellent. Freshest fish possible. As promised. Here's your scroll.
say:1:1623119001:1.female: Mmm, excellent. Freshest fish possible. As promised. Here's your scroll.

choice_prompt:2:1623119001.text: Mmm, excellent. Freshest fish possible. As promised. Here's your scroll.
choice_prompt:2:1623119001.source_cn: 真不错，是最新鲜的鱼。按照我们的约定，我把卷轴还给你。
choice_prompt:2:1623119001.male: Mmm, excellent. Freshest fish possible. As promised. Here's your scroll.
choice_prompt:2:1623119001.female: Mmm, excellent. Freshest fish possible. As promised. Here's your scroll.

say:3:1623119002:1.text: Nobody can tell me what to do! Why? Because I'm a cat!
say:3:1623119002:1.source_cn: 我想干什么就干什么，谁也别想管我！别问我为什么！因为我...
say:3:1623119002:1.male: Nobody can tell me what to do! Why? Because I'm a cat!
say:3:1623119002:1.female: Nobody can tell me what to do! Why? Because I'm a cat!

say:4:1623119003:1.source_cn: 拿着你的卷轴走吧，下次见。

say:0:1623120001:0.text: Finally... I'd better bring this back to Professor Hepler.
say:0:1623120001:0.source_cn: 总算拿到卷轴了……回去给赫普老师吧。
say:0:1623120001:0.male: Finally... I'd better bring this back to Professor Hepler.
say:0:1623120001:0.female: Finally... I'd better bring this back to Professor Hepler.

say:1:1623121001:1.text: Look at you! It went well, I guess?
say:1:1623121001:1.source_cn: 看你的表情，事情应该很顺利吧。
say:1:1623121001:1.male: Look at you! It went well, I guess?
say:1:1623121001:1.female: Look at you! It went well, I guess?

say:3:1623121002:1.text: Animals come in all temperaments, cats most of all. They're... famously unpredictable.
say:3:1623121002:1.source_cn: 动物的性子千差万别，尤其是猫，总带着点让人摸不透的脾气。
say:3:1623121002:1.male: Animals come in all temperaments, cats most of all. They're... famously unpredictable.
say:3:1623121002:1.female: Animals come in all temperaments, cats most of all. They're... famously unpredictable.

say:4:1623121003:1.text: Still, no real harm done. Consider it a little life injected into our overly well-behaved library.
